items.interpretation_short: Core life theme blends Personality Sun Gate 1 (Creativity) with Design Sun Gate 1 (Creativity).

items.career_theme: Work expression matures when Creativity is operationalized through Creativity.
items.relationship_theme: Relationships are shaped by balancing conscious Gate 1 with design Gate 1.

items.interpretation_short_ru: Ключевая тема жизни строится на сочетании осознанных Ворот 1 (Творчество) и бессознательных Ворот 1 (Творчество).
